name: Mighty Puffs Choco ragi

THIS PRODUCT CONTAINS 40% MILLETS Allergen Note: Made in a facility that processes wheat. May contain trace elements. Safety Advice: When feeding a child, please ensure they are sitting down and are supervised to redunte risk of choking. How To Store: Keep it in a cool, dry place.
